nav.title: Senthara ya vhukwamani ya AI
nav.subtitle: Thusedzo ya nyambo nnzhi na u tsireledza u fhandekanywa na muthu.

status.apiUnavailable: U dzhia / API a i vhonali

stats.providerQualification: U tea u tea ha mupedzi
stats.providerQualificationNote: Nyambo dzo lingiwa fhedzi dzo vhalwa

customer.title: Thoma muvhulafhungo
customer.consentText: Ndi tenda uri muvhulafhungo uyu u nga shumiswa nga mupedzi wa AI. Mibhalo i tsireledzwa phanda ha u vhulungwa.
customer.setupHint: A zwi konadzei u swika mulanguli a lugisa khii na mupedzi wa AI.
customer.noConversation: A hu na muvhulafhungo u shumaho
customer.startHint: Ita muvhulafhungo nga thendelo u thoma.
customer.chatEmpty: Mulaedza u a vhonala afha. Mishumo ya AI ndi nyeletshedzo fhedzi; a hu na u badela kana u shandukisa akhaunthe.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Ipfi la browser li rumelwa kha mupedzi; OpsCore a i ambei uri i vhulunga ipfi.
customer.voiceRequirement: Ipfi la browser li toda HTTPS, maikrofono, thendelo, mufuda wa Realtime na khii. A si luvingo.

queue.title: Muthethe wa u fhandekanya
queue.description: Muvhulafhungo u re na khombo kana wo humbela muthu u a vhonala afha. Muthethe ndi khumbelo, a si vhukwamani.
queue.empty: A hu na u fhandekanya kha tshigwada itshi.
queue.replyStorageNote: Mafhindulo a vhathu o tsireledzwa nga uri a vhonala kha muvhulafhungo.
queue.resolveNote: Yo fheliswa nga mushumi o newedzwaho.

boundaries.title: Mikhano ya mishumo
boundaries.automateBody: U fhindula u thoma nga nyambo nnzhi, u talutshedza, u sengulusa khombo na u vhulunga mibhalo.
boundaries.humanTitle: U fhandekanywa kha muthu zwi a toda
boundaries.humanBody: U humbela muthu, u sa tendi, khombo khulwane, milayo i siyo, muvhulafhungo wo sa fheli, nyambo ya tshidzumbe.
boundaries.notEnabledTitle: A zwi konadzei nga phakehe iyi fhedzi
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP, WhatsApp, imeili, luvingo, CRM na u khwathisedza nyambo zwi toda mupedzi wa ngoho na milingo.

handoffReasons.voice_review_required: U sengulusa ipfi zwi a toda

messages.qualificationNotice: A hu na luambo lo tendelwaho u swika milingo ya mibhalo, ASR, TTS na ipfi yo fhela.
messages.configOk: Nyolohelo i hone. Vhukwamani na khwalithi ya luambo zwi toda milingo ya ngoho.
messages.conversationCreated: Muvhulafhungo wo tsireledzwaho wo itwa. Khwalithi ya luambo a yo tendelwaho.
messages.handoffQueued: U fhandekanywa kha muthu ho vhewa kha muthethe ({reason}). Ndi khumbelo, a si vhukwamani.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Phindulo ya AI a yo fheli. A hu na mushumo wo itwaho. U nga humbela muthu.
messages.apiUnavailable: API ya vhukwamani a yo wanali. Dzhia kha OpsCore, nga murahu u khwinifhadza tsiaṱari iyi.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: U fhandekanywa ho vhewa kha muthethe ({reason}). Muthethe a u sumbedzi uri mushumi u hone.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: U fhandekanywa ho vhewa kha muthethe. Muvhulafhungo wa AI u a fhela; luvingo a lo lugisedzwaho.
messages.voiceCredentialRequest: U humbela khii ya ipfi ya tshifhinganyana…
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Mupedzi wa Realtime o sumbedza vhukhakhi. Fhelisa ipfi, sengulusa nyolohelo, nga murahu u linge.
messages.voiceActive: Muvhulafhungo wa ipfi u a shuma. Humbela muthu tshifhinga tshothe; hezwi zwi ita muthethe, a si luvingo.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Thendelo i a toda phanda ha u thoma muvhulafhungo.
errors.SERVER_RESPONSE_INVALID: Phindulo ya sevha a yo vhalei.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Mupedzi wa ipfi wa Realtime a o wanali.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Browser iyi a i tikedzi ipfi la Realtime.
